name: Incarnated Rage
text: While the bearer is leading a unit, every melee weapon carried by every model in that unit, the bearer included, has [LETHAL HITS].

effect.name: Incarnated Rage
effect.text: While leading a unit, the unit's melee weapons gain [LETHAL HITS].

name: Warp Locus
text: The area within 3 inches of the bearer counts as part of your Shadow of Chaos.

effect.name: Warp Locus
effect.text: Everything within 3 inches of the bearer is inside your Shadow of Chaos.
